rows.next_step: Assess generalizability of CRASH agent architecture.
rows.question: How can cognitive reasoning agents designed for incident reporting, such as CRASH, be adapted to automate safety incident analysis across diverse, non-standardized industrial domains?
rows.reason: The CRASH agent demonstrates automated, reasoning-based safety hazard analysis using LLMs, which may provide a blueprint for broader industrial safety applications beyond autonomous vehicles.
rows.title: Autonomous Safety Analysis in Complex Systems
